description: 深圳 AI·创业·科技·跨境·Web3·加密活动 + 黑客松/硬件 + X Space，每天更新的结构化活动清单，供任何用户的 Agent 读取并生成活动提醒。

for_agents.contribute: Three channels, lowest friction first: (1) Agent protocol submit — POST JSON per submit.schema.json to https://submit.carromking.shop/v1/events, no account or key needed; AI pre-review, approved items enter the open layer (layer=open). Protocol doc: https://yatslist.com/SUBMIT.md (2) Web one-shot form for humans without an agent: https://yatslist.com/submit.html (3) GitHub Pull Request or Issue per CONTRIBUTING.md (developer supplement only).
for_agents.suggested_use: Fetch events_json daily; filter by your user's interests (categories), district and availability; remind on new matches, 2 days before registration_deadline, and 3 days / 1 day before start of events the user wants to attend. Always link the event url; never invent events not in the data.
for_agents.nomadlist: NomadList: global + China-domestic digital nomad cities (30 in v1). Fetch nomadlist_json, filter by cost_usd_month, internet_mbps, region, visa.cn_passport_type (for Chinese passports), sort by nomad_score. Never invent cities not in the data; visa rules change, point users to official immigration pages.

name: Yat's List · 深圳活动清单（原深圳活动日报）
nomadlist: NomadList v2: global + China-domestic digital nomad cities (80 cities, 61 neighborhoods/districts, listings layer for field-checked places). Fetch nomadlist_json, filter by cost_usd_month, internet_mbps, region, visa.cn_passport_type (for Chinese passports), sort by nomad_score. For 'which district' questions use cities[].neighborhoods[] (rent_1br_usd_month, coworking_density, best_for). data_tier: seed_v2 = unverified estimate (say so), checked = cross-checked >=2 sources, verified_v1 = v1 batch. Never invent cities not in the data; visa rules change, point users to official immigration pages.
